subject: staring index for function col and other perhaps

messages.author: ab7b24da45678eac
messages.subject: staring index for function col and other perhaps
parts:
It looks like function col using indices staring from 0 now as in C/C+
+.

I am trying to standardize the data in block transformed data
as follows in vol1/stacks/stacks_normal.stan.
It turns out the estimation results are not the same.

data {
matrix(N, P) x;
}

transformed data {
real z[N, P];
for (n in 1:N) for (p in 1:P)
z[n, p] <- (x[n, p] - mean(col(x, p))) / sd(col(x, p))
}

By the way, if I want to do the standardization, could I
apply operations on say real x[N, P]?

--
Jiqiang

messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Re: [stan-dev] staring index for function col and other perhaps
parts:
On 2/16/12 11:33 AM, Jiqiang Guo wrote:
> It looks like function col using indices staring from 0 now as in C/C+
> +.

Good catch. The problem is that we're calling through
to functions that are indexed by zero, so it doesn't
look like array indexing to Stan, which is automatically
set to +1 to match R and BUGS rather than C.

I have to ponder a bit as to whether I can get away with
changing the function col() -- it's easy, but it leaves
the underlying C++ library inconsistent because
matrices are indexed with [] and () by 0 in Eigen.

>
> I am trying to standardize the data in block transformed data
> as follows in vol1/stacks/stacks_normal.stan.
> It turns out the estimation results are not the same.

> data {
> matrix(N, P) x;
> }
>
> transformed data {
> real z[N, P];
> for (n in 1:N) for (p in 1:P)
> z[n, p]<- (x[n, p] - mean(col(x, p))) / sd(col(x, p))
> }

This would be more efficient if you pull the
cols out first and loop the other way:

for (p in 1:P) {
vector x_p;
real sigma_hat;
real mu_hat;
x_p <- col(x,p);
mu_hat <- mean(x_p);
sigma_hat <- sd(x_p);

z[n,p] <- (x[n,p] - mu_hat) / sigma_hat;
}

I'm really going to have to figure out how to parse
and generate code for compound definition-assignments,
so this could be:

vector x_p <- col(x,p);
real mu_hat <- mean(x_p);
real sigma_hat <- sd(x_p);

> By the way, if I want to do the standardization, could I
> apply operations on say real x[N, P]?

I haven't added any operations like col() for array
data types, just matrices. They could be added
at some point. Eigen has some very elegant ways to
do things like this -- apply operations like standardization
by row or by column.

- Bob
